description: Price-tag test set for the live lens (FR-1). Open-licence photos from Wikimedia Commons; prices read and labelled by hand. 'price' is the amount in major units as written on the tag. Fuel boards drop the tenth-of-a-cent fraction. 'also_ok' lists real prices that are fine to show but not required (unit, regular, crossed-out, cut-off or background prices). Batch 2 (ids d…, collected 2026-10-14) adds US, Canadian and Australian shop photos. Batch 3 (ids w…, collected 2026-10-15) adds Japanese, Indonesian, Korean and European photos found through Openverse; these images are kept out of git (see .gitignore) and only their labels and OCR are committed. Batch 4 (2026-10-16) adds UK market, Greek shelf and Walmart sign photos, also through Openverse and kept local.
